set.body:
Objective
Bring the SimpleITK, AFNI, FSL dense and FSL coefficient oracles into the repo with provenance.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (Phase 4 (imported oracles)). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
fixtures; modules/transform/jvm/src/test/resources/scalafim/transform/oracle, tools/transform. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. itk_oracle, afni_oracle, fsl_dense_oracle, fsl_coef_oracle copied with manifest.json (tool versions, commands, SHA-256) and the neurotransform commit hash.
2. Generator scripts referenced or copied under tools/transform with license notice (MIT).
3. No real-subject data vendored; size budget recorded.

Verification
Hash read-back against manifests; resources load from a JVM smoke test.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P0.04: Vendor neurotransform native-tool oracle fixtures with manifests
